name: Glacier
notes: Active glacier ice and moraine edge (Alps, Alaska, Patagonia, Himalaya). Ice itself is plantless; snow algae tint the surface and a few lichens/pioneers cling to fresh moraine, so the list is near-empty by design.

ground.name: Snow algae
ground.source: Chlamydomonas nivalis (watermelon snow), cosmopolitan snowfield/glacier alga; pink surface film on summer snow (alpine and polar snow-algae literature)

ground.name: Map lichen
ground.source: Rhizocarpon geographicum, crustose lichen on moraine boulders worldwide, used for lichenometric dating of glacier retreat

ground.name: Glacier buttercup
ground.source: Ranunculus glacialis, Alps/Scandinavia/Arctic, moraine and snowbed to 4275 m, one of Europe's highest flowering plants, 3-12 cm

special.note: Catalogue plants (data/plants) whose band centres fall inside this biome's climate; computed, informational. Phase 6 may raise their density here so they are findable.
